title: Audited Gradients, Anchored Policies: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Flow Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.13203v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feedback controllers for flows are expensive to design, since each candidate must be evaluated with a high-fidelity solver. Differentiable surrogates reduce that cost, but they also introduce a failure mode that prediction error cannot detect. Policy optimization uses the derivative of the objective with respect to the action, which we call the action gradient and which can be computed either through the surrogate or through the high-fidelity solver. Optimization through the surrogate uses only its action gradient, and a surrogate can follow the flow trajectory closely while misestimating this derivative. The surrogate action gradient is compared against a central finite-difference estimate from the high-fidelity solver on held-out states, under acceptance criteria fixed before the comparison, and we call that comparison an audit. translated_title: 审计梯度，锚定策略：面向高效流动控制的基于模型的强化学习
translated_abstract: 流动的反馈控制器设计成本高昂，因为每个候选控制器都必须使用高保真求解器进行评估。可微代理模型降低了这一成本，但也引入了一种预测误差无法检测到的失效模式。策略优化使用目标函数对动作的导数，我们称之为动作梯度，该梯度既可以通过代理模型计算，也可以通过高保真求解器计算。通过代理模型进行优化时只使用其动作梯度，而代理模型可能在紧随流动轨迹的同时错误估计这一导数。我们将代理模型的动作梯度与高保真求解器在留出状态上得到的中心有限差分估计进行比较，并在比较前预先固定接受准则，我们将这种比较称为审计。当代理模型通过审计时，再将代理动作梯度拟合到低维反馈律上……
tldr: 提出一种“梯度审计”机制，在基于代理模型的流动控制策略优化中，依据预先固定的接受准则将代理模型的动作梯度与高保真求解器的有限差分估计进行比对验证，从而在大幅降低计算成本的同时避免代理模型梯度误差导致的策略失效。
en_tdlr: Proposes a gradient "audit" mechanism that validates surrogate action gradients against high-fidelity finite-difference estimates under acceptance criteria fixed in advance, enabling efficient model-based reinforcement learning for flow control while avoiding surrogate failures that prediction error alone cannot detect.
